主要内容: Optical Cable Corporation entered into a Second Loan Modification Agreement on February 28, 2017, extending the maturity date of its $7.0 million revolving line of credit to March 31, 2019. The agreement also removed certain previously existing provisions of the Revolving Loan that required reductions in the amount available to be borrowed originally contemplated to occur on February 28, 2017 and 2018. As a result, the collective maximum principal amount of the Revolving Loan will remain at $7.0 million. The Revolving Loan provides the Company the ability to borrow an aggregate principal amount at any one time outstanding not to exceed $7.0 million. Advances under the Revolving Loan accrue interest at adjusted LIBOR plus 2.50%. The Company currently has $4.4 million outstanding under the Revolving Loan. The Modification Agreement is attached hereto as Exhibit 4.1 and incorporated herein by reference.
